venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Not super busy but a good night. Started with an early pop, followed by a slow middle, finished with a late pop through close. Met a lovely young couple, Cindy and Vladimir, who were into the cocktails.

highlights.text: Typical Sunday pacing — early pop, slow middle, late pop through close

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Good morning start with 30 of 88 guests seated before 10am. 8-top and 11-top had great time. PM was chill and manageable; dining room and bar stayed near 70% through dinner. Place empty by 10:30pm. Sun Club had Brigid's first training day. Hot Eye had steady evening after bar crawl at 9. Guest Kierra Lynch, who previously had a bad experience, returned and left a 5-star review after fabulous dinner.

highlights.text: Guest recovery win — previously unhappy guest returned and left 5-star review

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: Mellow Sunday with lots of familiar faces. First couple hours sleepy — time for prep and cleaning. Nice push around 9pm filling room for remainder. Industry folks stopped by to close out the weekend. Sewage smell continued and was mentioned by a few tables but smoothed over.
maintenance_flags: Sewage smell persisting — mentioned by guests

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Very solid Sunday. Most reservations through Sakura Bar but floor also filled up — never went on a wait. Some early fumbles with great recoveries ensuring no guest left unhappy. Tonight was Nik's last night — amazing turnout of friends. High comps due to large staff turnout for Nik's farewell. Kitchen had steady night with prep done during downtime. Women's restroom first stall clogged.
maintenance_flags: Women's restroom first stall clogged — entered into Intellity by TRH

highlights.text: Nik's last night — big staff turnout drove high comps (9.12%)

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: First turn started chill, then hit nice 1k/hour flow from 7-10pm. Anomalous surfeit of large parties intensified by several packed into a 90-minute window — hit waitlist. Night slowed after 11pm with only 15 covers after that. Lots of industry friends — Matty Clark with Nevada, Taylor and Miles, friends of Max, and Joe from Dante's. Top sellers: Revenant, Masari, Deviltown.

highlights.text: Lots of large parties created brief waitlist; strong 7-10pm flow

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.notes_summary: Solid Sunday at 124. Steady pacing with good food push — 25% of all sales were food. Room never got halfway full but still beat target. Lots of crudo, oysters and fried chicken going out. Depleted some leftover event inventory. Kitchen AC still out and getting unbearable as weather warms.
maintenance_flags: No AC in kitchen — becoming unbearable

highlights.text: Strong food sales at 25% of total — crudo, oysters, fried chicken
Kitchen AC still out — urgent maintenance needed
